_README: Curated publisher domain -> trust tier for the web-search importer (scripts/ingest_websearch.py). Tiers steer ONLY the triage worksheet ordering and the provenance label; they NEVER enter evidence_score (score_evidence.py keeps its reproducibility guarantee). Every web hit is still source_type 'web_resource' (weight 0.25) and status 'candidate' awaiting human review. A result host matches a tier when it equals a listed domain or is a subdomain of it (suffix match); anything unlisted is 'open' and kept with a rank penalty and a visible marker. The trusted+watch set is kept a superset of resolve_source_url.CREDIBLE_DOMAINS (the URL resolver's open-web allowlist) so a publisher credible enough to resolve a URL never lands in 'open' here. trusted = intergovernmental / governmental / official-curriculum / peer-reviewed publishers; watch = foundations, think tanks, NGOs, consultancies, assessment vendors and education media (seriois, but full review). Edit this file only through a pull request, like the rest of the evidence graph.
